about: Starter ideas. Pick one, change anything, and let your AI tool fill in the rest of character-template.json.

starters.title: Night-time minimal
starters.idea: A calm city creature who lives at night. Oversized monochrome streetwear with one chrome detail.

starters.title: Soft romantic
starters.idea: A florist and part-time poet who dresses in lace, gingham and pastel knits. Golden-hour light everywhere.

starters.title: Quiet luxury
starters.idea: An architect who travels for work. Tailored, neutral, expensive-looking basics, never a visible logo.

starters.title: Y2K pop star
starters.idea: A bedroom pop singer with a bright bob, tinted glasses and playful, colourful outfits.

starters.title: Outdoor adventurer
starters.idea: A trail runner and photographer from the mountains. Technical outerwear mixed with vintage denim.
